Legends in ggplot2

Adding, titling, repositioning, customising, and removing legends

Complete guide to ggplot2 legends — auto-creation, title methods, label ordering, position control, appearance customisation, and removal.

How legends are created

A legend appears automatically whenever you map a variable to colour, fill, shape, size, alpha, or linetype inside aes(). No extra code needed.

# Sample data used throughout this page
set.seed(1)
df <- data.frame(
  x     = c(rnorm(300, -3, 1.5), rnorm(300, 0, 1)),
  group = c(rep("A", 300), rep("B", 300))
)

Adding a legend (by aesthetic mapping)

colour

library(ggplot2)

# Colour — creates a colour legend
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, colour = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

# Scatter with colour
set.seed(1)
df2 <- data.frame(x = runif(200),
                  y = 3 * runif(200)^2 + rnorm(200, sd = 2.5),
                  group = ifelse(runif(200) < 0.5, "A", "B"))

ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2)

fill

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

colour + fill together

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group, colour = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

alpha

ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y, alpha = y)) +
  geom_point(colour = 4)

shape

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, shape = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3)

Changing the legend title

Three equivalent options — choose the one that fits your workflow.

Option 1 — guides()

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Group"))

Option 2 — labs()

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(fill = "Group")          # or colour = , shape = , size = , alpha =

Option 3 — scale function name =

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Group")

Remove the title

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

Changing legend labels

# Rename labels with scale_fill_hue
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_hue(labels = c("Group 1", "Group 2"))

# Custom colours + labels at once
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("A" = "#e84855", "B" = "#2d6be4"),
    labels = c("A" = "Control",  "B" = "Treatment")
  )

Reordering legend labels

# Reorder by factor levels
df$group2 <- factor(df$group, levels = c("B", "A"))

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group2)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(fill = "Group")

Legend position

Default position is "right". Use theme(legend.position = ...) to change it.

# Top
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Bottom
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Left
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "left")

# None (remove)
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

Custom coordinates (inside the plot)

Set legend.position to a vector c(x, y) where both values are between 0 and 1 (fraction of the plot area).

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = c(0.2, 0.8),        # x=20%, y=80%
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80")
  )
TipRelated arguments
  • legend.justification — anchor point of the legend box (c(0,0) = bottom-left, c(1,1) = top-right)
  • legend.direction — "horizontal" or "vertical"
  • legend.box — arrangement when multiple legends: "horizontal" or "vertical"
  • legend.box.just — justification of entire legend box

Legend appearance customisation

Style the title

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(
      colour = "steelblue",
      size   = 11,
      face   = "bold",
      family = "sans"
    )
  )

Style the text labels

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey30")
  )

Background and border

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill   = "#f0f4ff",   # background colour
      colour = "steelblue", # border colour
      linewidth = 0.6
    )
  )

Key size

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"))   # width & height of colour keys

Override symbol size (scatter)

ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1)  # bigger symbols in legend
  ))

Horizontal legend with multiple rows

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

Removing a specific legend

When multiple aesthetics create multiple legends, you can remove just one:

# Remove only fill legend — keep colour legend
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = group, colour = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  guides(fill = "none")     # or guides(fill = FALSE)

Full styled example

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg,
                   colour = factor(cyl),
                   shape  = factor(am))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("4" = "#e84855", "6" = "#2d6be4", "8" = "#12a36a"),
    name   = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("0" = 16, "1" = 17),
    labels = c("0" = "Automatic", "1" = "Manual"),
    name   = "Transmission"
  ) +
  labs(title = "mtcars: Weight vs Fuel Economy") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "top",
    legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey85"),
    legend.key.size   = unit(0.9, "cm"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

Quick reference

Goal Code
Move legend top theme(legend.position = "top")
Move legend inside theme(legend.position = c(0.2, 0.8))
Remove legend theme(legend.position = "none")
Remove one legend guides(fill = "none")
Change title via labs labs(fill = "My title")
Remove title theme(legend.title = element_blank())
Rename labels scale_fill_manual(labels = c(...))
Reorder labels factor(var, levels = c("B","A"))
Bigger keys theme(legend.key.size = unit(1,"cm"))
Bigger symbols guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4)))
